step.cmd: In FTS, select the Rejected Transactions Retrieval (MR05) screen and select Search .
For the first record that is not yet reviewed, determine if the error code is one of the following:

ul.li: If the error code is 243 or 244, refer to Actioning a rejected transaction — Error codes C243 and C244 . Actioning a rejected transaction — Error codes C243 and C244
If the error code is 715, a specialized team corrects it. No further action is required.
If the error code is 921 due to a rejected Initial Decision (M103) transaction, IPOC corrects it. No further action is required.
For any other error code, go to step 3.

step.cmd: Select the 3-digit code to open WECS and view a detailed description of the error and go to step 4.
Determine if the error is a result of a BCS reject:
In BCS, select the appropriate BPC and select the Results tab. The requested update may have been changed to an estimate.
To view the WECS codes, select Exceptions/Errors/Warnings .
Determine if the error can be fixed, using BCS:
Select the estimated result, select Re-input Transactions and correct the information. To resolve the issue, refer to the appropriate procedure if necessary. Go to step 22.
Under the Results tab, select the estimated result that must be sent to IPOC and select the Forward via MM06 link.
When the Renewal/Revised (M106) transaction opens, complete the missing information as follows:
When the Operational Centre Memo (MM06) transaction opens, complete the missing information as follows:

ul.li:
Work item: Select the appropriate option:
For a net overpayment, select 91 - Overpayment .
For a net underpayment, select 93 - Manual pay system .

Work type: Select the appropriate option :
For a net overpayment, select 2 - Non-misrepresentation .
For a net underpayment, select 33 - Blocked claim requiring payment .

Remarks Line 2: Indicate all of the following, where it applies:
The appropriate error code.
Whether additional information is being provided on another Operational Centre Memo (MM06) transaction (e.g. page 1 of 3, page 2 of 3, etc.).
Whether it is urgent. If so, provide the reason (e.g. URGENT approaching time limitation for penalty).
FWW: Whether changes are required to the full work week (FWW).
Remarks Line 3: Leave this field blank.
Remarks Line 4: Leave this field blank.
Remarks Line 5: Enter your first name and last name.

Complete: Select C - Yes to complete the transaction on the last Operational Centre Memo (MM06) transaction. (If more than one Operational Centre Memo (MM06) transaction is required, D - No is pre-filled.)

step.cmd: Determine if this is an Integrity case:
In FTS, transfer the registration number to IPOC by selecting the appropriate registration number from the Registration Number (M025, M030, M035) transaction as follows:

ul.li: Registration flag: Select 4 - Insurance Payment Operational Centre .

step.cmd: Review and follow the instructions in WECS under Additional Information . Based on the WECS information, determine if the rejected information can be corrected by a Level 1 officer:
In FTS, determine if a registration number exists for the rejected transaction:

ul.li: If a registration number exists, go to step 16.

If there is no registration number, select the Registration Number (M025, M030, M035) transaction and assign one as follows:
Action: Select Assign .
Claim Source: Select 3 - Mail/Revised decision .
Service Unit: Select 1 .
Decision type: Select 3 - Revised .
Select Update .
Go to step 16.

step.cmd: Select the Renewal/Revised (M106) transaction to automatically generate an Operation Centre Memo (MM06) transaction as follows:

ul.li: Registration number: Select the appropriate registration number.

step.cmd: When the Operational Centre Memo (MM06) transaction opens, send the information to IPOC as follows:

ul.li: Work item: Select 92 - Purge and Recreate or 93 - Manual pay system .
Work type: Select 60 - Rejected transaction / or situation not otherwise listed that must be processed via purge and recreate or the work type appropriate to your situation.
Earnings to be allocated: Complete the weeks and amounts, if required.
Remarks Line 1: Indicate the exact transaction fields and data to be entered (e.g. BPC [XXXX], LRW [XXXX], COD [XXXX]).
Remarks Line 4: Enter your first name and last name.

step.cmd: To transfer the registration number to the IPOC, select the appropriate registration number from the Registration Number (M025, M030, M035) transaction as follows:

ul.li: Registration flag: Select 4 - Insurance Payment Operational Centre .

step.cmd: Review the rejected information. Re-input the transaction with the correct information. If necessary, refer to the appropriate procedure to resolve the issue.
Determine if a letter is required for the rejected transaction:
In ACS, create and send the appropriate letter for the rejected transaction.
In FTS, remove the SIN from the Rejected Transactions Retrieval (MR05) list as follows:

ul.li: Delete: Check the box next to the appropriate SIN.
